## Overview

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Family / class** | Empirical indicators → Length-based indicators |
| **Method name** | Length-based indicators (LBI) |
| **Short description** | Empirical length-based indicators that compare the length composition with life-history reference lengths (maturity, optimal length, $L_{F=M}$) in a traffic-light table. |
| **Main outputs** | Indicator ratios (e.g. Lc/Lmat, L25/Lmat, Lmean/Lopt, Lmaxy/Lopt, Lmean/LF=M) with traffic-light status |
| **Typical use case** | Length composition + Linf and maturity |

::: {.callout-tip}
## Basic entry
This page is populated with the information available so far. Full documentation will follow the pattern of the showcase entries ([FLicc](../../methods/dynamic-pool/flicc.qmd), [cpueTargeting](../../data-tools/cpuetargeting.qmd), [FishualizeR](../../data-tools/fishualizer.qmd), [mmsyFM](../../methods/multispecies/mmsyfm.qmd)). Use **Edit this page** (top right) or open a *New method entry* issue to contribute.
:::

First entry of the **empirical indicator** branch. Runs in the [Stock Monitoring Tool](../../training/smt.qmd). FLicc provides `lbi.hcr()` and `rfb.flicc.hcr()` for indicator-based harvest control rules.
